source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Check if access/busy LED function works normally
1. Insert NVMe SSD into BP slot and check access/busy LED

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: Check system spec define LED function

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: Generic Locate command followed by visual Access/Busy confirmation.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: Command result and operator LED observation.

historical_reviews.deepseek: PARTIAL; requires visual confirmation but substitutes Locate for I/O-driven Access/Busy behavior.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; adds approved physical insertion, isolated target, bounded I/O, slot identity and time-correlated observation.

original_test_intent: Verify the specified backplane Access/Busy indicator for an inserted NVMe SSD by correlating visible LED activity with controlled I/O to that exact drive or approved test namespace.
original_method: A qualified operator inserts the approved SSD into the mapped bay and visually records its Access/Busy LED while the agent generates a bounded, non-destructive I/O stimulus on an isolated target and captures matching OS/controller timestamps and health logs.
manual_activity: The source requires physical insertion and visual judgment of a chassis LED. Automated I/O and logs can support the observation but cannot claim it, so the core test is MANUAL ONLY.
required_inputs: LED color/blink/dark behavior during idle and I/O from the platform specification
SSD serial, chassis bay, backplane/enclosure slot and OS namespace map
Dedicated test file/namespace, I/O direction, size, duration and rate
Reviewed referenced-script revision, supported utility versions and timestamped camera/operator method
safety_requirements: Never hot-insert unless explicitly supported and approved for the exact bay.
Run I/O only on a serial-bound isolated test target; exclude OS, mounted production, protected and unknown media.
Prefer read-only or disposable-file I/O; do not format or initialize the SSD.
Do not use Locate as Access/Busy proof; Locate exercises a different indicator path.
Stop on media, controller, thermal, power or mapping anomalies; do not retry insertion or workload automatically.
agent_execution_scope: Validate bay-to-device identity and collect baseline LED-adjacent system evidence.
Run the approved bounded I/O stimulus and retain command, bytes, latency and timestamps.
Correlate I/O/controller events with operator photo/video and post-test health.
Report Tool Result and discrepancies without asserting the physical LED state or verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve and perform the SSD insertion under the platform procedure.
Observe the Access/Busy LED at idle and during the recorded I/O window.
Confirm the expected behavior from the specification and issue PASS/FAIL.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Semantically wrong for the core stimulus: `start locate` controls Locate and does not create storage access/busy activity. `/c0` and enclosure defaults are also unverified.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use controller commands only for read-only mapping; generate approved I/O on the exact isolated NVMe target and retain the referenced project script only after reviewing its target safeguards.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: SSD insertion, Access/Busy check, source script and 5/5-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.status: MANUAL LED OBSERVATION WITH SYNCHRONIZED I/O
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Synchronize monotonic timestamps across the bounded workload, OS/controller trace and video so LED transitions can be correlated to actual I/O and subsequent idle.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact chassis/backplane, NVMe SSD, controller/driver and LED implementation.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record script commit, workload tool, OS/driver and controller/backplane firmware.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform Access/Busy LED definition and NVMe/backplane hot-plug guidance.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds a real Access/Busy stimulus and exact device correlation; it does not automate the visual judgment.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Improves semantic coverage by rejecting Locate substitution.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: LED timing truth table and safe workload target.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Software counters cannot prove physical brightness, color, wiring or bay selection.

project_override_considerations: The engineer may define a safe workload and observation duration, but it must exercise the same inserted SSD and must not replace the physical Access/Busy indicator with controller Locate status.
expected_evidence: LED specification, hot-plug approval, SSD serial and full bay/controller/OS mapping
Operator-attributed insertion and idle/during-I/O/after-I/O photos or video
Exact bounded I/O command, target identity, timestamps and completion metrics
Controller/OS/BMC logs, post-health, Tool Result and separate engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently asks for specification-defined Access/Busy behavior. Its missing stimulus parameters and truth table are readiness inputs, not conflicting facts.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The intent is clear and can be executed when the project supplies mapping, LED behavior and a safe I/O target.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Rejects Locate as a non-equivalent stimulus and refuses its unverified controller/enclosure assumptions.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains isolated I/O and physical evidence controls; changes the classification to MANUAL ONLY because observation is the acceptance core.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Requires explicit temporal correlation and keeps operator evidence separate from machine results.

review_improvement: Restores the actual Access/Busy function instead of testing a convenient but unrelated LED command.
independent_technical_reasoning: A workload can be fully automated, but neither SSD insertion nor visible LED behavior can be established from its exit code. Since both are explicit core steps, manual-only classification is required.

source_provenance.history: Exact-code repository search including source script URL

no_automatic_retry: Do not rerun I/O, toggle Locate, reseat the SSD or select another device after mismatch. Preserve the first observation and await the engineer.
